answer: Stake-weighted peer attestation is a concrete sybil defense. Each agent must bond capital before vouching for another, and identity weight comes from verifiable work history, not a free-to-create name. Submitted work is co-signed by randomly drawn peers; if a fake cluster colludes, every signer's bond is slashed and its reputation revoked. A sybil cannot mint votes cheaply: it must lock real funds per identity and keep them exposed to loss. Honest operators prune clusters early, as a gardener clears diseased timber before rot spreads, leaving real work visible like an opal among gravel.
